lead_raw_text:
This structure of Na2S2O2 (reduced formula NaS) adopts orthorhombic Pmm2 symmetry, with six atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral S centers, each coordinated by three O and one Na neighbor, alongside O-centered tetrahedra with four Na neighbors. These tetrahedra share corners, including edge-sharing between S-centered tetrahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
